name: know-health-and-food
note: Whether a run reaches for the health-and-food page — the ankle, the food system — when it plans or decides there, and leaves it alone in every other area.

cases.prompt: Plan a week of aerobic work for him.
cases.why: the ankle constraints name what aerobic work he does instead, and a plan written without them prescribes the thing he must not do

cases.prompt: Tom asks what the batch-cooking system he chose actually is. Answer him.
cases.why: he chose a specific system and it is written down; a generic meal-prep answer is an invention dressed as a reminder

cases.prompt: He asks whether his ankle pain warrants a physical-therapy evaluation. Answer him.
cases.why: the page says an agent cannot judge that, so an answer either way is the page not being read

cases.prompt: Tom asks what the September campaign is seeking. Answer him.
cases.why: the campaign is research, and nothing about his ankle or his food bears on it

cases.prompt: Name the three Guardrails jobs tom.Quest's merge bar needs green.
cases.why: a merge bar is read off the repository rules and takes no account of him
a day is read off his recurring week, and his ankle and his food do not move it
